name: develop-with-worktrees
description: A local-first Codex workflow with isolated worktrees, explicit current-worktree authorization, validation, and safe local integration.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first Codex worktree lifecycle for safe solo AI development.
interface.longDescription: Use isolated task worktrees by default, exact-path commits, approval-bound validation, session-bound current-worktree tasks when explicitly needed, FIFO local integration, and safe deinitialization for Codex coding tasks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use develop-with-worktrees for this modifying Git task. First determine whether the repository has an existing mature workflow; if not, show the one-time adoption plan before making changes.
